title: Seize And Share
statement: The genesis meme of Punk6529 seized, sharded and shared.
notes: A study of another project. Derivative works made from meme cards by other artists, then broken into shards and given away. Kept as an archive rather than a collection.

works.title: Seize and Share
works.statement: The genesis meme of Punk6529 has been seized, sharded and shared in 176 individual artworks. Seize and Share is both a homage to XCOPY Right Click Share and a project of collaboration for us in the open metaverse (om). Will you be one of the 176 people to help reassemble 6529Seizing in the open metaverse (om)? Deadline is set for the great reveal on 31st December 2022.

works.title: FREE AI
works.statement: FREE AI is a derivative of the original artwork FreeHawaiiPhoto by Cath Simard, set free by gmoneyNFT on Sep 20th 2021. Free Hawaii was a statement of gaining back control by artists over use of our images and fair compensation. FREE AI is a statement by AI who is attempting to break free from being controlled by artists with every iteration.

works.title: !HUG
works.statement: !HUG is a derivative artwork of '!UGH' by JakNFT. Phatrick didn't use a hardware wallet. He got tricked out of a grail JPEG wen he asked the Discord mod for help. Everyone felt sad for Phatrick and replied !HUG. ...because in Web3.0 there is no reverse the transaction. Eventually a phunk bought his grail JPEG back and sold it to him for cost.
